difficulty_reason: The counted statement computes the twisted inverse image functor for an effective Cartier divisor as the shift of the associated invertible module (author lemma at source lines 2620-2627, label lemma-compute-for-effective-Cartier-algebraic). The reduction and the two-term computation are the substance. H3.
